description: V7 stratified BFZI V150 cold-only reference plan

domain.core: all 12 normalized geometry coordinates are within [0.05, 0.95]
domain.boundary: one or two coordinates enter the outer 5% of the global bounds
domain.extreme: three or more coordinates enter the outer 5% of the global bounds
domain.inference: core only; final nearest-neighbour coverage threshold is calibrated from V7 validation core samples
